name: stacked-area-chart
title: Stacked area chart
description: A React stacked area chart that shows how a total builds from its parts, with a 100% mode, a crosshair listing every series and morphing data. Accessible.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Stacked area chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/stacked-area-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { StackedAreaChart, StackedAreaTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/stacked-area-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
